body.name: GS
body.type: selected maximal ancestral graph induced by actual functional dependence in an SCM
body.def: \(G_S(M)\) is obtained from the minimal structural graph whose parent relations are functional dependencies outside exogenous null sets, tested over all endogenous input assignments including assignments off the observational support, by retaining \(S\), latent-projecting, and applying selected-MAG projection
